assumptions.assumption: The total income (denominator) covers only income records that link to a member with a major, so the fractions sum to 1 across colleges. Income with no linked member or major is excluded.
Fractions are returned as unrounded decimals (0 to 1), not percentages.

alternatives.interpretation: The denominator is the total of all income records, including those with no linked member or major, so the fractions may sum to less than 1.

assumptions.assumption: The total income used as the denominator covers only income records that link to a member with a major (the same set of rows as in the numerator), so the fractions sum to 1.
Income records with no linked member or with a member lacking a major are excluded, because the request says to link each income record through the member to the major.
Fraction is returned as an unrounded decimal ratio (0 to 1), not a percentage.

alternatives.interpretation: The denominator is the total income across all income records, including those that cannot be linked to a member's major, so the fractions may sum to less than 1.
